turns.question: How much of our campaigns' budget was left at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: EUR 4,130 of the campaigns' budget was left at the end of September 2026 (the month of 1 to 30 September 2026, each campaign's last budget snapshot in the month added up across campaigns).
